text:
lin: FYI hit a nasty bundler -> edge failure that I think is new. Terser + rollup commonjs path strips the SDK default constructor shape when preserveModules=false and mangle properties is enabled. Repro attached below.
reza: ugh, mangle properties? we usually avoid that. can you paste minimal steps?
lin: short repro: rollup config uses commonjs plugin + terser with mangle_props: true (to shave bytes). Import like `import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'` then `const c = new Redwood(...)` -> build + run in miniflare -> runtime: `TypeError: Redwood is not a constructor` or `c.createCompletion is not a function`.
lin: rollup.config.js snippet:
```js
plugins: [nodeResolve(), commonjs(), terser({ mangle: { properties: true } })]
```
anya: mangle properties will rename object keys like `createCompletion` unless they are quoted. But normally libs avoid mangleable property names. Is the SDK exposing methods via assignment to prototype or re-exports that become flattened?
lin: exactly. SDK ESM build does `class RedwoodClient { async createCompletion(...) {} } export default RedwoodClient;` but the CJS interop build emits `exports.default = RedwoodClient; exports.createCompletion = RedwoodClient.prototype.createCompletion;` or similar in a helper file when bundlers try to shim. Terser mangle_props renames `createCompletion` in one file but not everywhere, breaking linkage.
dana: wow. two fixes: 1) avoid mangle_props at app builds (we should document this for edge builds) or 2) SDK should avoid exposing prototype methods via re-exported property names (prefer named exports or a stable cjs shim).
reza: can we add tests to our bundle CI that run terser with common settings to catch this? also add advisory in onboarding docs: "do not enable mangle properties for edge bundles when consuming the SDK".
lin: repro commands I used: 1) clone https://github.com/lin/repro-redwood-terser (internal link available) 2) npm i 3) npm run build:rollup 4) npx miniflare dist/worker.mjs -> request -> see errors.
anya: temporary workaround in consumer: `import * as RedwoodNs from '@redwood/inference'; const Client = RedwoodNs.default || RedwoodNs.RedwoodClient;` or prefer named `import { RedwoodClient }` if available. Also using `terser` with `mangle.properties: { regex: '^_$' }` to restrict.
dana: SDK TODOs: publish strict exports map, add tiny compatibility cjs file that sets `module.exports = exports.default = RedwoodClient` and avoid emitting separate property re-exports that tooling might rename. Add a bundle-test step that minifies with terser mangle_props to catch regressions.
build-bot: Created ticket RED-3999: "terser mangle_props breaks SDK interop in edge bundles" assigned to @dana.
lin: I'll upload the tiny repro and a README with the rollup+terser flags so QA can reproduce. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
